smart-gemini-bounded.purpose: small bounded agent tasks only; every member is capped by its own per-minute input budget, so this primitive never advertises a long context
smart-gemini-bounded.reason_not_emittable: no small-budget member is wire-qualified yet; emitting the route would claim a capability no target can serve

smart-gemini-chat.reason_not_emittable: no wire-qualified chat member remains unclaimed

smart-gemini-long-context.purpose: prompts sized against a million-token per-minute budget
smart-gemini-long-context.reason_not_emittable: every remaining member was already claimed by a more specific primitive; a second leg over the same models would spend one provider-model quota twice

smart-gemini-vision.reason_not_emittable: the deployed Gemini leaves declare vision = false; the two wire-qualified Lite models are not image-qualified in the deployment, so a vision primitive would promise what they refuse

smart-gemini-antigravity.reason_not_emittable: agent.run has no adapter; see adapter_requirement

smart-gemini-live.reason_not_emittable: session.live has no adapter; see adapter_requirement

smart_gemini.reason_not_emittable: only 1 primitive(s) have an executable candidate; a composite needs two legs before reparenting the live composite buys anything, and emitting a primitive without it would give one provider-model quota a second route
smart_gemini.note: children must be routes, never other composites; a child that a request is not cleared for is dropped before dispatch, so an uncleared request falls through instead of being sent to Google

non_google_fallback.note: the egress gate already drops a Google leg for an uncleared request before dispatch; what the graph must guarantee is that the legs after it are strict non-training targets
